title: Expressing an immediate need
learner_outcome: Given a clear visual and auditory situation, the learner orally produces a minimal I need + noun construction to express an immediate need, then reuses the same pattern for a different nearby need with strictly less support.

skills.description: Express an immediate need orally with a relevant and intelligible I need + noun construction, then reuse the pattern for a different nearby need with less support.

required_evidence: A separate comprehension check confirms the immediate communicative intention before production; it is preparation evidence only and does not establish independent receptive mastery.

The learner produces an own oral I need + noun construction that is relevant to a clear visual and auditory situation and sufficiently intelligible, without Spanish, transcript or a complete sentence model in the final evidence.
The learner transfers I need + noun to a different nearby need using one of the approved nouns and strictly less support than in the preceding supported production.
lesson_scope: One minimal unit for a learner with very low or no English in Phase 1 — Mental unblocking.
One communicative intention only: expressing an immediate need.
Direct construction through intention → Person → Action → oral production.
Conceptual coverage of exposure, instruction, practice, own production, evidence and transfer without prescribing candidate activities or stages.
Transfer to a different nearby immediate need with strictly less support.
language_scope: The only productive pattern is I need + noun.
The complete approved productive vocabulary is water, help and food.
pronunciation_scope: Functional pronunciation of the complete I need + noun phrase, prioritizing intelligibility rather than phonetic perfection.
Comprehensible production of I and need.
Fluent delivery of the short phrase with natural linking into the noun.
No phoneme, including /iː/, may become an independent Skill or pronunciation objective.
content_constraints: Use exactly one integrated Skill and do not create separate Skills for comprehension, vocabulary, grammar or pronunciation.
Use no more than the three approved productive nouns: water, help and food; do not add other required productive vocabulary.
Do not introduce plurals, adjectives or articles as productive objectives.
Do not introduce I want, Can I have..., Please give me... or any alternative productive structure.
Use Person + Action only as a direct-construction scaffold and never as a complete sentence for the learner to copy.
Require the learner's own oral production, remove the complete sentence model before evidence and reduce support progressively.
Require transfer to a different nearby need with strictly less support than the preceding supported production.
Use Spanish only as optional rescue and a transcript only as later support under Strict Support Timing; neither may form part of final evidence.
Treat comprehension as preparation and checking, not as independent receptive mastery.
Do not reuse the historical mission, pedagogical stages, conversations, exercises, evidence or LessonExperience content.

Use exactly the approved curricular lesson identity a1-u1-l1 in the future candidate.
Use LessonExperience contract_version 3.0 in the future candidate.
Leave candidate_revision undecided until the candidate phase.
Use relevance and intelligibility as the future qualitative production review dimensions through human or external review; automatic evaluation must not accredit them.
Keep comprehension, own production and transfer evidence structurally separable in the future candidate.

Do not create or activate a candidate, loader, admission, publication, membership, frontend or B181 work from this specification.
